# Limits and error codes

## Limits

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| Frame size | 1048576 bytes |
| UI tree nodes | 2000 |
| UI tree depth | 32 |
| Table rows a plugin may send | 10000 |
| Panels per plugin | 32 |
| One stored value | 262144 bytes |

These are not friction to be negotiated away. The host renders a plugin's tree eagerly on its
own main thread, so they are what stands between a buggy plugin and a host-side stall.

## Error codes

`retryable` says whether waiting can help. `E_QUOTA` is not retryable because deleting is the
fix; `E_RATE_LIMIT` is, and carries `retryAfterMs` — **retrying before it is a bug in your
plugin**, and the user pays for it, not you.

| Code | Retryable | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `E_PROTOCOL` | no | The frame was not a valid protocol envelope. |
| `E_BAD_REQUEST` | no | The request parameters were missing, mistyped, or out of range. |
| `E_UNKNOWN_METHOD` | no | No such method in this protocol major. |
| `E_SCOPE_DENIED` | no | The plugin does not hold the scope this method requires. |
| `E_ACCOUNT_DENIED` | no | The plugin was not granted access to that account. |
| `E_RATE_LIMIT` | yes | The plugin's rate budget is exhausted. Wait retryAfterMs before retrying. |
| `E_TIMEOUT` | yes | The call did not complete before its deadline. |
| `E_CANCELLED` | no | The call was cancelled before it completed. |
| `E_TOO_LARGE` | no | The payload exceeded a protocol size limit. |
| `E_CAPABILITY_DENIED` | no | The plugin does not hold the capability this method requires. |
| `E_QUOTA` | no | The plugin's storage quota is exhausted. |
| `E_DRY_RUN` | no | The action was logged but not performed: this plugin is in dry-run. |
| `E_UNAVAILABLE` | yes | The host subsystem needed for this call is not currently available. |
| `E_UPSTREAM` | yes | VRChat returned an error for this request. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | yes | The peer failed unexpectedly while handling this call. |
